Today's dinner chat could focus on how technology needs protection just like we do. It’s important to know that sometimes our digital systems might face tests to see if they're strong enough.

A simple test you and your kids could try is seeing how many different websites use the same password. If more than one site uses the same password, it’s time to change them.

Let's keep talking about these important things together. Take care!
